title: Dependency Upgrades Need Compatibility Verification
content:
# Dependency Upgrades Need Compatibility Verification

**Standard ID:** ENG-STD-006

## Rule

Major or minor upgrades of shared libraries, frameworks, or runtime versions must include:

1. A compatibility checklist against dependent services
2. Automated test results on the upgraded version
3. A staged rollout plan (canary or percentage deploy) for production
4. A documented revert path to the previous lockfile / image tag

## Rationale

Dependency bumps without verification have repeatedly caused cascading build and runtime failures across teams.
